text: Which genes enhanced in Kupffer cells (single-cell) and in classical monocytes (blood immune cells) are not secreted into the blood?
plan: Cell type category (scRNA): Kupffer cells / Cell type enhanced AND Immune cell category (RNA): Classical monocyte / Immune cell enhanced AND NOT Secretome annotation: Secreted to blood
understanding: Identify genes that have enhanced RNA expression in Kupffer cells based on single-cell data, enhanced expression in classical monocytes among blood immune cell types, and are not classified as secreted into the blood.

trail.why: The requirement specifies genes that are enhanced in Kupffer cells, which precisely matches the 'Cell type enhanced' category for the cell type 'Kupffer cells'.

trail.requirement: enhanced in classical monocytes (blood immune cells)
trail.why: This filter selects classical monocytes at Level 1 and the category 'Immune cell enhanced' at Level 2 to match genes with enhanced expression in classical monocytes.
The requirement isolates proteins that are secreted into the blood to exclude them from the query.

requirements.why: I chose 'Cell type category (scRNA)' because the question specifies single-cell context, matching single-cell RNA specificity across cell types including Kupffer cells rather than tissue-specific deconvolution ('Cell type enrichment (RNA)').

requirements.requirement: enhanced in classical monocytes (blood immune cells)
requirements.why: This field covers specificity/enhancement across flow-sorted blood immune cell types, specifically classical monocytes.
This field categorizes predicted secreted proteins by destination, including 'Secreted to blood', which should be excluded using the NOT operator.
